summary: Notifo is a self-hosted notification server that aggregates and dispatches alerts across multiple channels like email, SMS, and push notifications. It provides developers with a centralised API and JavaScript plugin to manage messaging workflows from a single backend. This allows you to control message delivery and user preferences without relying on third-party communication services.
goodFor: Developers or teams who need a self-hosted broker to unify outbound alerts and messaging across various channels into one system.
watchOut: The project has low maintenance activity, meaning you may need to patch security vulnerabilities or bugs yourself.
deployNotes: As a C# application, it typically runs inside a container and requires a persistent database backend along with a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
